style: stylized 3D animated comedy, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: a wiry female spotted hyena office worker, big bright cobalt-blue shirt, wide tangerine-orange harness on her chest; leans 45 degrees forward, ears pinned back on every pull; dry, serious, never smiles
